accepted.reason: GHSA-xcx6-jx8p-x3h5 is in MSAL Node's authorization-code flow (interactive sign-in). CloudBuilder only uses service-principal secrets (ClientSecretCredential), never that flow. The fix is two major versions up and not yet used by any @azure/identity release: move when @azure/identity depends on msal-node 7.1 or newer.
High only through @azure/msal-node (see that entry): no advisory of its own. It is used for ClientSecretCredential, which does not use the affected flow.
